happy 3 month anniversary my babyy. who could've known time flies by so fast, i just cant help but forget time exists when im around you. it was always like that with you — your eyes, your sweet gentle smile, it always warmed my heart to see you smiling. you've always looked so pretty, if anything you look prettier with every passing day. i cant help but fall in love with you deeper the more i know you.

i'm always thinking about you and hoping you love me as much as i love you. i adore you so much and value you so much, and i promise to be the best husband i can be for you. i wish that fate would always bring us togethor, and we'd get to live this love one day in halal, when we're married, and then you can finally know how deeply i love you, my baby.

i love you like the stars love the sky, khadoujti.
